judul: CPMK 1: Ulasan P1–P3 (Parts of Speech, to be, Present Simple)

hero.title: Satu Halaman untuk Persiapan CPMK 1
hero.text: File modul P4 isinya sama dengan P3 (Module 3: Everyday Life), jadi pertemuan ini dijadikan ulasan CPMK 1: parts of speech, to be, a/an, negara & kebangsaan, present simple, jam, dan in/on/at. Tab Kuis berisi 76 soal latihan gabungan (bukan soal ujian asli).

cheatsheet.heading: Strategi CPMK 1
cheatsheet.html: Untuk setiap soal grammar, tanyakan tiga hal: (1) subjeknya siapa? (I / he-she-it / you-we-they), (2) ada kata kerja atau tidak? (tidak → be, ada → do), (3) kalimat apa? (+ / − / ?). Tiga pertanyaan itu menjawab sebagian besar soal P2–P3.

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 1 • Peta Materi
cheatsheet.title: Apa yang Wajib Dikuasai
rows: 7 kelas kata; jenis noun/pronoun/verb/adjective/adverb; in/on/at; FANBOYS; morning vs in the morning
am/is/are, singkatan, Yes I am/No I'm not, Wh- questions, a/an + jobs, country–nationality, kapital
present simple I/you/we/they, do/don't, kolokasi kata kerja, jam past/to, in/on/at waktu, Me too/Me neither

modes.label: Paling sering
modes.title: to be
modes.text: Hampir pasti keluar: memilih am/is/are, jawaban singkat, dan a/an.

modes.label: Paling menjebak
modes.title: be vs do
modes.text: Are you like…? ✗ → Do you like…? ✓. Dan jam half past nine = 09.30.

options.label: Tanpa kata kerja
options.title: → Am/Is/Are + S …?
options.code: Are you from Bandung?  Is she a nurse?  Are they married?
options.text: Jawaban: Yes, I am. / No, she isn't.

options.label: Dengan kata kerja
options.title: → Do + S + V1 …?
options.code: Do you live in Bandung?  Do they work long hours?
options.text: Jawaban: Yes, I do. / No, they don't.

options.label: Wh-
options.title: → Wh + be/do + S …?
options.code: Where are you from?  Where do you live?  What time do you get up?
options.text: Kata tanya di depan, sisanya sama dengan pertanyaan yes/no.

modes.label: P2
modes.title: Short answer
modes.text: Yes, I am / Yes, she is / Yes, they are.

modes.label: P3
modes.title: be vs do
modes.text: Hanya satu auxiliary per kalimat sederhana.

flashcards.q: Cek 3 langkah sebelum menjawab soal grammar?
flashcards.a: Subjek siapa? Ada kata kerja (do) atau tidak (be)? Kalimat +, −, atau ?
Noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, conjunction.
For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So.

flashcards.q: Short answer untuk Is he married?
flashcards.a: Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.

flashcards.q: an atau a: engineer, doctor, actress, university?
flashcards.a: an engineer, a doctor, an actress, a university.
Do they + V1? Do they speak Italian?
quarter to three; twenty-five past nine.

flashcards.q: at / on / in: night, Sunday, the evening?
flashcards.a: at night, on Sunday, in the evening.

ringkasan:
*RANGKUMAN CPMK 1 BAHASA INGGRIS (P1–P3)*
1️⃣ Parts of speech: noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, conjunction (FANBOYS).
2️⃣ to be: I am / he-she-it is / you-we-they are. Yes, I am. No, I'm not.
3️⃣ a/an + pekerjaan (lihat bunyi): an engineer, a doctor, a university.
4️⃣ Country→nationality: Spanish, Chinese, Italian, French, Polish.
5️⃣ Present simple: I/you/we/they + V1, don't + V1, Do…? Yes, I do.
6️⃣ be (tanpa kata kerja) vs do (ada kata kerja).
7️⃣ Jam: past (≤30), to (>30), half past nine = 09.30. at night, on Sunday, in the morning.

parts.label: Langkah 1
parts.title: Cari kata kerja
parts.text: Kata kerja = aksi/kebiasaan (live, work, go, eat, like). Nama pekerjaan, umur, asal, kata sifat BUKAN kata kerja.

parts.label: be
parts.title: am / is / are
parts.text: Pilih sesuai subjek: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are.

parts.label: do
parts.title: do / don't
parts.text: Di P3 hanya I/you/we/they. Untuk he/she/it nanti memakai does/doesn't (P5).

parts.label: be −
parts.title: Negatif
parts.text: S + be + not: isn't, aren't, I'm not.

parts.label: be ?
parts.title: Tanya
parts.text: Be + S …? Jawab: Yes, I am.

parts.label: do ?
parts.title: Tanya
parts.text: Do + S + V1? Jawab: Yes, I do / No, I don't.

materi.label: Bagian 2
materi.title: Ringkasan P1: Parts of Speech
materi.html:
• Noun: concrete, abstract, common/proper, collective.
  • Pronoun: personal, reflexive, interrogative, demonstrative.
  • Verb: transitive (butuh objek), intransitive, auxiliary (be/have/do).
  • Adjective menjelaskan noun; adverb menjelaskan verb (manner, place, time, frequency).
  • Preposition: time/place/direction. Conjunction: coordinating (FANBOYS), subordinating, correlative.

materi.label: Bagian 3
materi.title: Ringkasan P2: People and Places
materi.html:
• to be untuk nama, asal, umur, pekerjaan, status: I'm Rina. I'm from Malang. I'm nineteen. I'm a student. I'm single.
  • Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
  • a/an + jobs berdasarkan bunyi.
  • Country → nationality dan aturan huruf kapital.

materi.label: Bagian 4
materi.title: Ringkasan P3: Everyday Life
materi.html:
• Present simple I/you/we/they: V1, don't + V1, Do…?
  • Kolokasi: live in/with, work for/long hours, go to/out/home, have breakfast.
  • Jam: past/to, quarter, half.
  • at (jam, night, the weekend), on (hari), in (morning/afternoon/evening).
  • Me, too / Me, neither.

materi.heading: Tips mengerjakan soal pilihan ganda
materi.html: Baca seluruh kalimat dulu, cari subjeknya, lalu coret opsi yang jelas salah bentuknya (mis. I is, don't likes). Untuk soal jam, tulis angkanya di kertas dan gambar jam kecil.

items.en: Hello, my name's Rina. I'm from Malang.
Are you married? No, I'm not.
Do you live with your parents? Yes, I do.
I get up at half past five.
I don't watch TV in the morning.
